selection: For each outer family, minimize family-balanced LFC squared-error ratio over other available H1/Orion/CD4 inner families, with BOTH outer and inner excluded. Choose rank/lambda/alpha only using inner outcomes. Primary count comparators use matching selected full STRING hyperparameters for panel-only and randomized-embedding controls. Construct candidate independently inner-selected.
mean_gate: Before any generated-count or reserve work, a primary candidate must improve family-balanced masked LFC MSE by>=1% and masked LFC MAE by>=0.5% versus held-family V24; worst-family MSE ratio<=1.02; beat matched random and panel-only variants on both MSE and MAE. Full true-DE effects are not used to pick magnification.
scope: Exploratory on already-studied public families; no fresh blind claims. Whole-Orion (HCT116+HEK293T) excluded together. Whole-CD4 excluded across all conditions. Replogle K562/RPE1 are one family vote. Source-specific output and embedding preprocessing never use another family. Own targets excluded from exact bilinear loss; missing outputs abstain.
guide_scope: Published pseudobulk construct labels and fold_expr available; distinct promoter/transcript constructs are heterogeneous interventions, not individual guide replicates. Construct random-effects mean only when>=2 effective constructs. Single-construct labels unchanged. Query efficiency remains unobserved.
conditional_work: Count tests and subsequent learnable-mean population transport/full transition adaptation require a passing mean finalist. No donor reserve, packaging or upload before count and reserve gates.
